public_rationale: Under the broad reading of 'companies,' Imbue is a counterexample. Its company policy essay advocates regulation and enforcement, and the Legislature listed it as an SB-1047 supporter before the post. This defeats the universal claim without needing to settle the alternative-proposal branch. It does not establish that Marcus knew of Imbue's position or that OpenAI, Microsoft, or Alphabet supported the bill.
limitations: The result depends on including smaller AI companies; restricting the claim to the named large firms would leave this evidence insufficient.
The company article has a 2023 publication date but records a 2026 update.
The legislative records establish support during the campaign, not a separate endorsement of each June amendment.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: As far as Marcus knows, none of the AI companies that said they support AI regulation is supporting SB-1047 or offering a substantive alternative.

statement.excerpt: And (as far as I know) not one of the companies that previously stood up and said they support AI regulation is standing up for this one, or offering anything substantive in its place.
statement.document_title: The misguided backlash against California’s SB-1047

from_speaker: previously stood up and said they support AI regulation
offering anything substantive in its place
our_interpretation: Assess the public record, not Marcus's private knowledge.
The ordinary broad reading includes smaller AI companies that had publicly advocated regulation, as well as the large companies named in context.
A substantive alternative must specify regulatory duties or enforcement mechanisms and be offered as an alternative to this bill; generic earlier statements alone do not suffice.
Assess publicly expressed positions during the bill's introduction-to-post period, with earlier advocacy used to establish membership in the claimed group.
criteria.support_condition: A sufficiently complete contemporaneous record shows that no qualifying company publicly supported SB-1047 or offered a substantive replacement by June 7, 2024.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one company with an earlier public pro-regulation position publicly supported SB-1047 or offered a substantive replacement before the post.
